rationale: hammernik_2017-claude-agentic: vn_T=4, vn_n_filters=16, vn_kernel=9, vn_n_bumps=31, vn_x_range=2.0, vn_filter_init_std=0.05, vn_rbf_init_std=0.01, vn_lambda_init=0.02, epochs=30, batch_size=2, lr=0.00096, grad_clip=1.0, train_n=400, val_n=200, seed=42, max_train_s=1550, rationale=iter-5 (six-box). LAMBDA SWEEP COMPLETE: iter-1 lambda=0.0097 hr=0.5777; iter-3 lambda=0.02 hr=0.5921 BEST; iter-4 lambda=0.05 hr=0.0 (RMSE 2.1e-3->1.27e-2, SSIM 0.9866->0.9334 -- COLLAPSE). FAILURE MODE (iter-4): lambda over-anchoring -- above ~0.02 the data-fidelity term drives each step too hard toward y_NN=FBP-of-NOISY (which carries sparse-view streaks), degrading the recon. The lambda optimum is a bracketed interior maximum at ~0.02. Lambda is now fully characterized -> DONE with it; RESET to the iter-3 winner (lambda=0.02) and evolve the ARCHITECTURE. ONE KNOB: vn_T (unroll/cascade depth) 3 -> 4 (the core VN capacity lever; one extra data+regularizer GD step of the variational energy). HYPOTHESIS: with lambda fixed at its optimum, a deeper unroll gives one more streak-suppression step, lifting hr above 0.5921; predict hr > 0.595, OR diminishing returns if T=3 already saturates the tiny 16-filter bank. All else = iter-3 (filters=16, kernel=9, n_bumps=31, x_range=2.0, epochs=30, lr=9.6e-4, batch=2, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42, train_n=400). BUDGET: T=4 is ~1.33x iter-3's per-step cost -> 30 full epochs ~1580s, still UNDER the 1800s SLURM kill; max_train_s=1550 guards the wall so all 30 epochs complete (NO iter-2-style under-training). batch_size=2 (512px OOM guard).
